# Zaflick

> Zaflick is an Indian athleisure brand, made by Zaflick Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd. Seven pieces for women and men, designed in India to be worn from a morning session through the rest of the day, not only at the gym. Zaflick is in pre-launch: the first drop has not been released, prices have not been announced, and every product image on the site is a concept. The first drop opens to the early list first.

Key facts:
- Pieces for her: tank top with built-in support, active legging with a deep side pocket that holds a phone, sports bra (medium support), fitted jacket.
- Pieces for him: active T-shirt (boxy, drop-shoulder), wide-leg pants (drawcord waist), athleisure shorts.
- Designed after surveying nearly 200 people and interviewing more than a dozen about what goes wrong with activewear in India.
- Fabric chosen for heat and humidity, being tested for see-through and pilling. Sizing graded on Indian body measurements.
- Early list (free): see the real samples first, buy 48 hours before the public launch, free shipping on the launch order.
- Ships in India to start. Launch date not public yet.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofzaflick/
